result.instructions: Tools for Omise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which payments failed this week, and what were the failure codes?"; "What is our current balance and how much of it is transferable?"; "Refund 2,500 THB of charge chrg_… because the order was cancelled.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Omise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run omise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run omise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run omise_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. omise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: omise_get_account
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: Return the Omise account behind the secret key: id, email, business details and transfer settings.

tools.name: omise_get_balance
tools.title: Get the balance
tools.description: Return the current balance: total, transferable and reserve amounts, in the account currency.

tools.name: omise_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: List payments (charges). Pass order reverse_chronological for newest first. Filter by status, customer or time window.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start (default 0).

from.description: Earliest UTC time, ISO 8601, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: Latest UTC time, ISO 8601, for example 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z.

status.description: Charge status, for example successful, failed, pending, reversed or expired.

customer.description: Only charges of this customer id.

tools.name: omise_get_charge
tools.title: Get a charge
tools.description: Return one charge by id: amount, status, card, refunded amount, failure code and metadata.

tools.name: omise_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer record (email, description, metadata). Creates no charge and moves no money.

metadata.description: Metadata as string key/value pairs (sent as metadata[key]=value).

tools.name: omise_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Change a customer's email, description or metadata. Other fields stay unchanged. Setting the same values again has no effect.

metadata.description: Metadata as string key/value pairs (sent as metadata[key]=value).

tools.name: omise_update_charge
tools.title: Update a charge
tools.description: Change a charge's description or metadata only. The amount and the payment are not changed.

metadata.description: Metadata as string key/value pairs (sent as metadata[key]=value).

tools.name: omise_capture_charge
tools.title: Capture a charge
tools.description: Capture an authorized charge so the money moves to the account. Omit capture_amount to capture the full authorized amount. Only charges created without immediate capture can be captured.

capture_amount.description: Amount to capture in the smallest unit. Omit for the full authorized amount.

tools.name: omise_create_refund
tools.title: Create a refund
tools.description: Refund money from a charge to the card holder. A refund is final and cannot be undone. The amount cannot exceed the refundable balance of the charge.

amount.description: Refund amount in the smallest unit of the charge currency.

reason.description: Reason to record, up to 255 characters.

metadata.description: Metadata as string key/value pairs (sent as metadata[key]=value).
